title: SandpaneProjectContext
description: A7 project.context (design 2026-10-09 §3.7 item 9): params and result. Hand-synced with sandpane_protocol::{ProjectContextParams, ProjectContextResult, RepositoryContext, DetectedManifest}. Only syntax-checked by `make schema-lint`; not read by the value-set drift gate. Read-only and bounded: only ROOT manifests of registered repositories are read (O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW root + identity check, race-safe O_NOFOLLOW leaf reads, 256 KiB per file); Core runs no tool. Suggestions and notes are UNTRUSTED display strings: never auto-approved, never run.

manifest.description: Root file name: package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod, GNUmakefile/makefile/Makefile, build.gradle.kts/build.gradle (with a gradlew file), pyproject.toml.

suggestedCommands.description: Argv vectors; approving one goes through verification.approve with argv shown exactly.

notes.description: Each at most 512 bytes (a cut note ends with an ellipsis). May quote script text from the repository verbatim (untrusted).

unreadable.description: Root file names nothing was taken from (over 256 KiB, a symlink, a UTF-8 BOM, invalid JSON, not a regular file, unreadable). "." = the repository root itself could not be opened or failed the identity check.
